entities.summary: Arthur Andreas Arntzen was a Norwegian journalist, humorist, actor and writer. He wrote several humorous books, and is particularly known as the stage character "Oluf Rallkattli". His awards include Spellemannprisen, the Leonard Statuette, and the Order of St. Olav.
